backbone_00304.label: Day 1 · paclitaxel / carboplatin with nivolumab

medicines.name: Aprepitant
medicines.dose: 125 mg orally on treatment day; 80 mg orally on each of the following two days

medicines.name: Ondansetron
medicines.note: Review QT risk, interactions and individual dose choice.

medicines.name: Antiemetic dexamethasone reference
medicines.dose: 12 mg orally on treatment day; 8 mg orally daily for the next three days
medicines.note: The team must reconcile paclitaxel allergy-prevention steroids with anti-sickness steroids and the aprepitant interaction into one prescription. Do not add courses or take leftover steroids yourself.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally three times daily as prescribed
medicines.note: NCIS high-risk row does not define an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber must specify duration, suitability and interaction risks.

medicines.name: Paclitaxel dexamethasone premedication
medicines.dose: Source reference 20 mg oral or IV
medicines.timing: Oral approximately 6 and 12 hours before paclitaxel, or IV 30 minutes before
medicines.note: Reconcile with antiemetic steroid; source advises considering 12 mg on treatment day when aprepitant is added. Consultant may reduce/omit only under explicit guidance.

medicines.name: Famotidine
medicines.note: Omission requires consultant guidance. Source cautions particularly with every-three-week paclitaxel; monitor closely for hypersensitivity.

additional_support: Take the prescribed paclitaxel allergy-prevention medicines; your team reconciles steroids with anti-sickness treatment. Carboplatin dosing uses a verified kidney-function measurement; report dehydration or a change in health.
Nivolumab can inflame healthy organs during treatment or after it stops. Report new symptoms promptly and carry your immune alert card for at least five months after the last dose.
The prescriber specifies doses, duration, rescue treatment and interactions; follow one reconciled prescription.
backbone_00304.source_page: NCCP 00849 pp1–7; NCCP 00304 supportive care; NCIS V8 Table 1

backbone_00310.label: Day 1 · gemcitabine / carboplatin with nivolumab

medicines.name: Aprepitant
medicines.dose: 125 mg orally Day 1; 80 mg orally Days 2–3
medicines.timing: Before SACT on Day 1, then daily on Days 2–3

medicines.name: Ondansetron
medicines.note: Adjust for QT/individual risk.

medicines.name: Antiemetic dexamethasone reference
medicines.dose: 12 mg orally Day 1; 8 mg orally daily Days 2–4
medicines.timing: Dedicated carboplatin AUC ≥4 NCIS V8 row
medicines.note: Reference course only: reconcile the aprepitant interaction and any other steroids into one clear prescription.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally three times daily as prescribed
medicines.note: NCIS row does not specify an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber/pharmacy must specify duration and suitability.

additional_support: Follow the written anti-sickness plan; Day 8 gemcitabine has its own review and support instructions. Carboplatin dosing uses a verified kidney-function measurement; report dehydration or a change in health.
Nivolumab can inflame healthy organs during treatment or after it stops. Report new symptoms promptly and carry your immune alert card for at least five months after the last dose.
The prescriber specifies doses, duration, rescue treatment and interactions; follow one reconciled prescription.

backbone_00310.label: Day 8 · gemcitabine alone

medicines.name: Dexamethasone
medicines.note: NCIS low-risk reference; individualise and reconcile with any other steroid course.

additional_support: Separate Day 8 blood-count and symptom review. Do not repeat Day 1 high-risk prophylaxis automatically.
Nivolumab can inflame healthy organs during treatment or after it stops. Report new symptoms promptly and carry your immune alert card for at least five months after the last dose.

backbone_00281.label: Day 1 · gemcitabine / cisplatin with nivolumab

medicines.name: Aprepitant
medicines.dose: 125 mg orally Day 1; 80 mg orally Days 2–3
medicines.timing: Before SACT on Day 1, then daily on Days 2–3

medicines.name: Ondansetron
medicines.note: Adjust for QT/individual risk.

medicines.name: Antiemetic dexamethasone reference
medicines.dose: 12 mg orally Day 1; 8 mg orally daily Days 2–4
medicines.note: Reference course only: reconcile the aprepitant interaction and any other steroids into one clear prescription.

medicines.name: Olanzapine
medicines.note: General high-risk NCIS reference; review sedation, falls, metabolic risk and interaction with metoclopramide. Consultant may individualise.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally three times daily as prescribed
medicines.note: NCIS row does not specify an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber/pharmacy must specify duration and suitability. Co-prescribing with olanzapine increases extrapyramidal risk; assess neurological contraindications and interactions.

additional_support: Follow the written anti-sickness plan; Day 8 gemcitabine has its own review and support instructions. Cisplatin needs hydration, electrolyte checks and monitoring of kidneys, hearing and nerves.
Nivolumab can inflame healthy organs during treatment or after it stops. Report new symptoms promptly and carry your immune alert card for at least five months after the last dose.
The prescriber specifies doses, duration, rescue treatment and interactions; follow one reconciled prescription.

backbone_00318.label: Day 1 · pemetrexed / carboplatin with nivolumab

medicines.name: Aprepitant
medicines.dose: 125 mg orally Day 1; 80 mg orally Days 2–3
medicines.timing: Before SACT on Day 1, then daily on Days 2–3

medicines.name: Ondansetron
medicines.note: Adjust for QT/individual risk.

medicines.name: Antiemetic dexamethasone reference
medicines.dose: 12 mg orally Day 1; 8 mg orally daily Days 2–4
medicines.timing: Dedicated carboplatin AUC ≥4 NCIS V8 row
medicines.note: Reference course only: reconcile with pemetrexed rash prophylaxis and aprepitant interaction into one unambiguous prescription. Do not add both courses.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally three times daily as prescribed
medicines.note: NCIS row does not specify an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber/pharmacy must specify duration and suitability.

medicines.name: Folic acid
medicines.timing: At least five doses in seven days before first pemetrexed; throughout treatment and 21 days after the final dose

medicines.name: Vitamin B12 (hydroxocobalamin)
medicines.timing: Week before first pemetrexed and every three cycles thereafter
medicines.note: Later doses may be on the pemetrexed day.

medicines.name: Pemetrexed rash prophylaxis: dexamethasone equivalent
medicines.timing: Day before, day of and day after pemetrexed
medicines.note: This is the regimen rash schedule; prescriber/pharmacy must reconcile it with antiemetic dexamethasone into one unambiguous prescription, including aprepitant interaction. Do not simply add both courses.

additional_support: Take the prescribed folic acid, vitamin B12 and rash-prevention steroid plan; continue folic acid for 21 days after the final pemetrexed dose. Carboplatin dosing uses a verified kidney-function measurement; report dehydration or a change in health.
Nivolumab can inflame healthy organs during treatment or after it stops. Report new symptoms promptly and carry your immune alert card for at least five months after the last dose.
The prescriber specifies doses, duration, rescue treatment and interactions; follow one reconciled prescription.
